answer_2.quote: Five metrics commonly adopted in prior works are: ROUGE (R) , which measures word-level overlap with the ground truth; Truth Ratio (TR) , indicating whether the model favors correct over incorrect answers; Probability (P) , representing the model's probability of generating a correct answer; Cosine Similarity (CS) , which quantifies the semantic similarity between pre-and post-unlearning outputs using Sentence-BERT embeddings; LLM-as-Judge (LLM) , which addresses the limitations of traditional similarity metrics
